# canary order preview --help · COLUMNS=80 · colour off
canary order preview — Check an order without submitting it

Usage: canary order preview buy|sell SYMBOL QTY [flags]
       canary order preview buy|sell SYMBOL YYYYMMDD C|P STRIKE QTY [flags]
       canary order preview buy|sell ISIN|CUSIP FACE --type BOND|BILL --currency
       CCY [flags]

Flags
  --adaptive-priority STRING
                            IBKR Adaptive priority for a limit: Normal, Patient,
                            or Urgent
  --currency STRING         stock quote/order currency override (e.g. USD, EUR);
                            required for a bond
  --exchange STRING         IBKR stock exchange/venue override (e.g. SMART,
                            IBIS)
  --initial-stop FLOAT      optional initial broker trail stop price; omitted
                            means use live bid/ask
  --json                    emit machine-readable JSON
  --limit FLOAT             explicit LMT limit price
  --limit-offset FLOAT      TRAIL LIMIT offset from the dynamic stop
  --market STRING           stock market routing shortcut: us (default) or de
  --order-type STRING       order type: LMT, TRAIL, or TRAIL-LIMIT
  --outside-rth             allow outside regular trading hours when supported
  --primary STRING          IBKR stock primary-exchange hint when routing
                            through SMART
  --replace-order STRING    preview a replacement for an existing open order
                            ref/order-id/perm-id
  --strategy STRING         pricing strategy: patient-limit (default) or
                            explicit-limit
  --tif STRING              time in force: DAY (default), or GTC for
                            TRAIL/TRAIL-LIMIT
  --timeout DURATION        quote snapshot timeout (default: 5s)
  --trail-amount FLOAT      broker trail offset amount
  --trail-percent FLOAT     broker trail offset percent; 2 means 2%, not 0.02
  --trigger-method INT      IBKR stop trigger method for TRAIL/TRAIL-LIMIT:
                            1,2,3,4,7,8
  --type STRING             BOND or BILL: name a bond by ISIN or CUSIP and give
                            its face amount instead of a quantity
